Draven.combo: Save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit instead of using it first when you need to dodge Draven E Stand Aside.
Draven.laning: Don’t give Draven a chance to kill you while he has two Draven Q Spinning Axes; farm safely. If trading is difficult, let Draven step forward to create an opening for your jungler.
Draven.build: Build armor first because Draven’s main damage is physical. Also get enough health to stay out of the execution range of Draven R Whirling Death, and consider lowering his attack speed to reduce the basic attacks you take.
Draven.escape: Draven has no separate skill to create distance, so go in with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit when Draven E Stand Aside is down and he has fewer axes. Delay your engage if Draven E Stand Aside is available or he has two axes, and keep Lucian E Relentless Pursuit available for dodging and disengaging.
Draven.fight: Use Lucian Q Piercing Light where Draven Q Spinning Axe will land to pressure him to catch or give up the axe. Take short trades when Draven has only one axe or has lost them all. If Draven E Stand Aside is down, you can close the gap with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit.
Draven.phase: Don’t trade with Draven while he has two axes early. Lucian is strong in short trades early, so take an advantage when Draven has fewer axes. In mid game, target Draven when he’s alone with your team to shut down the lead he built early. In late game, Lucian is disadvantaged in long fights, so repeat fights where you deal brief damage and pull back.
Draven.teamfight: Approach from the side or follow up to finish a target caught by crowd control instead of leading with a direct engage. Mark them with Lucian W Ardent Blaze before going in to gain movement speed, and save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit for disengaging.
Draven.watch: While Draven has two Draven Q Spinning Axes, his basic attacks hit hard, so avoid trading. Draven W Blood Rush increases his movement and attack speed, and its cooldown can reset, so watch where he goes to catch an axe and adjust your distance. Beware the slow and forced movement from Draven E Stand Aside. After dodging the first hit of Draven R Whirling Death, move out of the return path too.

Nilah.watch: Immediately after Nilah Q Formless Blade hits, her attack range increases and her attacks deal area damage, so take another step back. Keep your distance from allies so several of you aren’t pulled in by Nilah R Apotheosis.
Nilah.build: Build armor first and add health to withstand the physical damage from Nilah Q Formless Blade, E Slipstream, and R Apotheosis. Nilah Q Formless Blade has armor penetration, so don’t rely on armor alone. If healing prolongs fights, get Grievous Wounds; if the enemy support has healing, consider Executioner's Calling earlier.
Nilah.teamfight: Keep your distance from allies so several of you aren’t caught by Nilah R Apotheosis. If you’ve already been pulled in, attack Nilah immediately to stop her from continuing the cast. After Nilah engages and uses W Jubilant Veil and E Slipstream, follow up and attack if an ally immobilizes her. Use Lucian W Ardent Blaze to gain movement speed, and save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to disengage.
Nilah.combo: If Nilah can engage again, don’t use Lucian E Relentless Pursuit in your combo; save it to disengage.
Nilah.escape: Don’t engage just because Nilah E Slipstream is down. Wait until Nilah engages, uses W Jubilant Veil, and becomes immobilized. If you’re too far away then, close the gap with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit and deal brief damage. Save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit if Nilah R Apotheosis is available or you need an escape route.
Nilah.fight: While Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active, don’t waste basic attacks; attack again after it ends. Save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to create distance when Nilah can engage.
Nilah.laning: Use Lucian Q Piercing Light on a front minion to harass Nilah behind it. Push the wave, but retreat behind your minions after trading.
Nilah.phase: The available information doesn’t establish which champion has the advantage in the mid or late game, so take repeated short trades to suit Lucian’s weakness in extended fights.

Samira.escape: Right after Samira E Wild Rush is used, she has a harder time closing the gap again. If you’ve also dodged the enemy support’s crowd control, you can go in with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit. If Samira used Samira E Wild Rush to engage and nobody died, deal short burst damage during that opening and back off.
Samira.phase: The available information isn’t enough to determine which champion is stronger in the mid or late game. Since long fights favor the opponent, Lucian should keep taking short trades and backing off.
Samira.teamfight: Approach from the side or follow up instead of initiating head-on, and finish a target already caught by crowd control. Before closing in, apply the mark from Lucian W Ardent Blaze to gain movement speed, and save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to disengage. If an ally is caught, watch out for Samira P Daredevil Impulse engaging. Don’t leave low-health allies behind so Samira can’t chain resets on Samira E Wild Rush.
Samira.build: Build armor first because the main damage from Samira Q Flair, Samira W Blade Whirl, and Samira R Inferno Trigger is physical. Armor cannot block the magic damage from Samira P Daredevil Impulse and Samira E Wild Rush.
Samira.combo: If Samira’s re-engage would be dangerous, save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to disengage.
Samira.fight: If Samira E Wild Rush is down and nobody has died, there’s an opportunity for a short fight.
Samira.laning: Lucian’s short range makes him easy to harass, so push the wave and use Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to dodge the enemy support’s engage. Use Lucian Q Piercing Light on a front minion to harass Samira behind it, then retreat behind minions after trading.
Samira.watch: While Samira W Blade Whirl is active, it destroys projectiles and basic attacks, so attack after it ends. If you’re hit by the enemy support’s crowd control, Samira can close in with Samira P Daredevil Impulse, so dodge their engage ability first. When Samira R Inferno Trigger starts, look for a chance to interrupt it with an allied immobilizing effect or knockback.

Sivir.escape: When Sivir E Spell Shield is down, you have an opening to engage. Sivir has no ability to create distance, so close in with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit, but save E if you need it to avoid an engage from the enemy support.
Sivir.build: Prioritize armor against the damage from Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and Sivir W Ricochet. The information provided does not specify which item to buy first.
Sivir.fight: Sivir has no ability to create distance, so when her Spell Shield is down, Lucian E Relentless Pursuit can close the gap. Keep the fight short even after you engage.
Sivir.laning: Use Lucian Q Piercing Light on a front minion to poke Sivir behind it. Push the wave in advance or prepare for an ally to catch it before leaving lane, since Sivir clears waves quickly. After trading, fall back behind minions and avoid the return path of Sivir Q Boomerang Blade.
Sivir.phase: In the mid game, account for Sivir's fast wave clear and clear the wave before leaving lane. In the late game, keep taking short trades and backing off instead of committing to long fights.
Sivir.teamfight: While Sivir R On The Hunt is active, only take short fights around terrain and vision, and wait for the effect to end. When Sivir E Spell Shield is down, you have a chance to target her, but approach from the side or follow up rather than engaging head-on, and finish a target already caught by your team's crowd control. Apply the mark from Lucian W Ardent Blaze before closing in, and save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to disengage.
Sivir.watch: Sivir Q Boomerang Blade can hit both on the way out and on the return, so if the first hit lands, move out of its return path. Sivir E Spell Shield blocks one ability, so check whether it is down before using Lucian Q Piercing Light. When Sivir R On The Hunt is active, the entire enemy team moves faster, so avoid long chases.

Twitch.teamfight: When Twitch R Spray and Pray is active, spread out to the sides from your allies so you do not all get hit by his piercing basic attacks. When Twitch's location is revealed, coordinate with your allies to focus the same target. Lucian should approach from the side or follow up to finish a target caught by crowd control, and save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to disengage.
Twitch.laning: Push the wave and use Lucian Q Piercing Light on a front minion to poke Twitch behind it. After trading, move behind minions immediately to avoid taking several basic attacks. If Twitch disappears from lane, tell your allies he may be rotating to another lane and watch out for paths without vision.
Twitch.build: Buy a Control Ward early to prepare for Twitch Q Ambush. Twitch E Contaminate deals two types of damage, so building either resistance only blocks part of it; resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Twitch P Deadly Venom. Consider your total health and ways to reduce attack speed, but prioritize taking fewer basic attacks.
Twitch.combo: Save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit if you urgently need to disengage rather than engage.
Twitch.escape: Twitch has no ability to create distance, so engage when you can safely close in after leaving the cloud from Twitch W Venom Cask. If you cannot confirm Twitch's location after Twitch Q Ambush, secure vision first. If you have taken several basic attacks or are trapped by Twitch W Venom Cask, use Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to create distance.
Twitch.fight: Twitch has no ability to create distance, so when you have a safe angle to engage, you can close the gap with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit. Do not prolong a fight inside Twitch W Venom Cask; get out.
Twitch.phase: The provided information is not enough to determine who has the advantage in the mid or late game. Lucian's strengths diminish as fights drag on, so keep attacking briefly and backing off.
Twitch.watch: Twitch can appear after being unseen with Twitch Q Ambush, so reveal visionless brush and narrow paths first or go around them. If Twitch W Venom Cask lands under you, leave immediately to reduce Deadly Venom stacks. If you have taken several basic attacks, create distance even if your health still looks safe, since Twitch E Contaminate may finish you.

Tristana.laning: Push the wave toward Tristana's turret to make last-hitting difficult. Use Lucian Q Piercing Light on a front minion to poke Tristana behind it. After trading, fall back behind minions, but do not stand close to allied minions where Tristana E Explosive Charge can hit you with area damage.
Tristana.teamfight: Apply the mark from Lucian W Ardent Blaze, then approach from the side or follow up to finish a target already caught by your team's crowd control rather than engaging head-on. Save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to disengage. If an ally is taken down, Tristana W Rocket Jump resets and she can chain into another engage, so retreat immediately and do not leave a vulnerable ally in front.
Tristana.watch: Tristana E Explosive Charge deals area damage around a minion when she kills it, so do not stand close to allied minions. If Tristana W Rocket Jump and Tristana R Buster Shot are both ready, do not engage carelessly. Watch out for the stun and displacement from Tristana R Buster Shot, and save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to dodge it.
Tristana.combo: If Tristana W Rocket Jump and Tristana R Buster Shot are available, assess the danger before using Lucian E Relentless Pursuit in your combo.
Tristana.escape: Once you confirm Tristana R Buster Shot is down too, engage with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit and deal damage in a short trade.
Tristana.fight: Take short trades when Lucian Q Piercing Light and Lucian P Lightslinger are ready. When Tristana W Rocket Jump is down, you have a chance to close the gap with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit, but weigh the risk carefully if Tristana R Buster Shot is still available.
Tristana.phase: Use Lucian's short, strong trades to gain an advantage early. In the mid game, use that lead to pressure the lane and turret and look for a chance to end the game. Tristana is difficult to handle once her build is complete, so play to avoid fights that drag on into the late game.

Varus.laning: Lucian has short range, so push the wave and use Lucian Q Piercing Light on a front minion to poke Varus behind it. If Varus's basic attacks have stacked Blight on you or Varus E Hail of Arrows is on the ground, do not continue trading there; back off. After a trade, move behind minions and save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit in case the enemy support looks for an engage.
Varus.teamfight: Approach from the side or follow up to finish a target already caught by your team's crowd control rather than engaging head-on. Apply the mark from Lucian W Ardent Blaze before closing in to gain movement speed, and save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to disengage. If Varus R Chain of Corruption hits an ally, spread out so the tendrils do not spread. Keep your distance briefly after Varus gets a takedown or assist.
Varus.watch: When you see Varus Q Piercing Arrow being aimed, sidestep its path. If an ally is caught by Varus R Chain of Corruption, spread out so the tendrils do not reach you.
Varus.build: Prioritize armor against the physical damage from Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows.
Varus.escape: When Varus R Chain of Corruption is down or Varus is aiming Varus Q Piercing Arrow, you have a chance to close the gap. While he is aiming, sidestep the arrow's path before going in; Lucian E Relentless Pursuit can close the gap to Varus. Varus has no ability to create distance.
Varus.fight: When Varus slows himself to aim Varus Q Piercing Arrow, move out of its path and close the gap.
Varus.phase: In the mid and late game, keep dealing damage in short bursts and backing off instead of prolonging fights. Wait out the few seconds after Varus gets a takedown or assist, when he becomes stronger.

Jinx.escape: Jinx has no skill to create distance on her own, so go in when Jinx E Flame Chompers! is down. If Jinx W Zap! also misses, that’s a good time to close the gap with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit. If these conditions aren’t met, save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to dodge an engage from the enemy.
Jinx.teamfight: Approach from the side or follow up to finish Jinx when she’s already caught by crowd control instead of going in head-on. Mark her with Lucian W Ardent Blaze before engaging to gain movement speed, and if possible, save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit for disengaging. Don’t start a fight right after an ally is killed or a structure is destroyed and Jinx P Get Excited! activates.
Jinx.build: Build armor first. Jinx’s main damage is physical, and armor won’t block the magic damage from Jinx E Flame Chompers!. The available information isn’t enough to choose a specific first item.
Jinx.combo: Line up with Jinx before using Lucian R The Culling. You can maintain your angle during the cast with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit.
Jinx.fight: Trade briefly when Jinx pokes with her rocket launcher, since she won’t have minigun attack speed stacks. If Jinx E Flame Chompers! is down and Jinx W Zap! misses, close the gap with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit.
Jinx.laning: When Jinx attacks minions with her rocket launcher, avoid standing right next to a minion so you don’t also take area damage. You can use Lucian Q Piercing Light on a front minion to harass Jinx behind it. Trade when Lucian Q Piercing Light and Lucian P Lightslinger are ready, then move back behind your minions immediately.
Jinx.phase: Build a lane advantage early with Lucian’s strong short trades. In mid game, keep taking brief approaches, dealing damage, and disengaging with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit. Lucian falls behind other marksmen in long fights late, so avoid extended fights against Jinx too.
Jinx.watch: Dodge the root from Jinx E Flame Chompers!. The moment Jinx W Zap! misses is your chance to approach. Don’t stay within range of Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket! when health has been reduced.

Caitlyn.phase: Caitlyn’s relative strengths diminish as the game goes on, so don’t force things early. Continue to favor short trades over Lucian’s long sustained fights later on.
Caitlyn.build: Prioritize tenacity to reduce the root from Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap and movement speed to close the gap.
Caitlyn.escape: Avoid paths where Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap has been placed, and save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit when you need to dodge an engage from the enemy support.
Caitlyn.fight: Look for a trade right after Caitlyn uses Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker to clear the wave.
Caitlyn.laning: Don’t overextend and give up a kill because of the range difference. Farm under your turret if needed.
Caitlyn.teamfight: Approach from the side or follow up to finish a target already caught by crowd control instead of leading with a direct engage. Mark them with Lucian W Ardent Blaze before approaching to gain movement speed, and save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit for disengaging.
Caitlyn.watch: Stepping on Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap roots you and increases the range of Caitlyn P Headshot, dealing heavy damage, so change your approach around bushes and narrow paths. When Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker comes your way, stand behind an allied minion to take reduced damage.

Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness passes through allies or minions, slowing enemies and healing allies, so move out of the line between Senna and her target. Senna W Last Embrace roots you after a short delay, so move away from allies as soon as you’re marked, and usually dodge it from behind minions. If Senna hits you once, back away immediately so she can’t gain mist with a second attack.
Senna.build: Senna’s main damage is physical, so build armor first to withstand it. Senna P Absolution adds damage based on your current health to her basic attacks, so build armor along with health instead of stacking health alone.
Senna.combo: If you need Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to dodge Senna W Last Embrace, save it instead of using it in your combo.
Senna.escape: The moment after Senna W Last Embrace misses or is blocked by a minion is a chance to close the gap. Go in with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit for a short trade, but if you see Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, watch out for camouflaged enemy allies engaging and retreat to an area with vision.
Senna.fight: Senna has no dash to create distance, so Lucian E Relentless Pursuit can close the gap. Save E if you may need it to dodge a dangerous root.
Senna.laning: Push the wave and use Lucian Q Piercing Light on a front minion to harass Senna behind it. Watch where Senna is likely to step out to collect a soul, then pressure her to disrupt her mist collection. After trading, retreat behind minions to block Senna W Last Embrace.
Senna.phase: Keep gaining an advantage with short trades in the mid game and avoid letting fights drag on. In the late game, Senna’s range and attack damage grow as she collects mist, so it’s important to stop her from collecting souls early.
Senna.teamfight: Approach from the side or follow up instead of initiating head-on, and finish a target already caught by crowd control. Before closing in, apply the mark from Lucian W Ardent Blaze to gain movement speed, and save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to disengage. If you see Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, retreat to establish vision, or use Lucian Q Piercing Light in its area to deter an engage.

Ashe.fight: Take short trades when Ashe W Volley is down and Ashe Q Ranger's Focus has worn off. Don’t use Lucian E Relentless Pursuit first when you need to be ready for Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow.
Ashe.escape: Look for a chance to go in with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit when Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow and Ashe W Volley are both down. If Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active, keep your distance until it wears off. After trading, don’t try to walk away while continuing to take hits from Ashe P Frost Shot; consider using Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to disengage.
Ashe.laning: Push the wave and use Lucian Q Piercing Light on a front minion to harass Ashe behind it. Move back behind your minions as soon as the trade is over.
Ashe.phase: In mid game, it’s still best to make short approaches and deal damage while Ashe W Volley is down. In late game, Lucian may fall behind in extended teamfights, so repeat fights where you attack briefly and pull back.
Ashe.teamfight: Approach from the side or follow up to finish Ashe when she’s already immobilized instead of leading with a direct engage. Mark her with Lucian W Ardent Blaze before approaching to gain movement speed, and save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit for disengaging.
Ashe.watch: Ashe W Volley is an area slow used to poke, so dodge it by moving sideways and look to trade right after it’s down. Ashe P Frost Shot’s slow refreshes with each basic attack, so don’t stay in range of Ashe’s basic attacks for long. Keep your distance while Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active, and don’t start a small fight out of vision while Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available.

Aphelios.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil doesn’t hit several of you. Mark a target with Lucian W Ardent Blaze, then approach from the side or follow up to finish a target caught by crowd control. Save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit for disengaging.
Aphelios.build: Build armor first against Aphelios’s main damage. If a long fight makes his healing difficult to deal with, consider anti-heal after building resistances.
Aphelios.escape: Dodge Aphelios’s Gravitum slow and Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites root, or go in after that threat has passed. When Aphelios doesn’t have Severum, his escape options are limited, so look for a chance to close the gap with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit then.
Aphelios.fight: Check Aphelios’s weapons and take short trades when his immediate burst damage is low.
Aphelios.laning: Push the wave, then use Lucian Q Piercing Light on a front minion to harass Aphelios behind it.
Aphelios.phase: Lucian is strong in short trades early, so he needs to build a lane advantage. The available information doesn’t establish who has the advantage in mid and late game, so choose when to fight based on Aphelios’s weapons and repeat short bursts of damage instead of taking long fights.
Aphelios.watch: If Aphelios slows you with Gravitum, get out of range before Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites roots you. Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil deals an extra attack from his main weapon for each champion hit, so spread out from your allies when he can use it.

MissFortune.teamfight: Don’t engage inside the zone from Miss Fortune E Make It Rain; draw her outside it. Gain movement speed from the mark of Lucian W Ardent Blaze, then approach from the side or follow up to finish a target that is already immobilized. If Miss Fortune R Bullet Time starts, coordinate with an ally who can interrupt it with crowd control. If it can’t be interrupted, move to the side of its cone and save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to disengage.
MissFortune.build: The available information doesn’t specify a particular item to buy, but if you build resistance, prioritize armor. The main damage from Miss Fortune P Love Tap, Q Double Up, and R Bullet Time is physical, while armor does not block the magic damage from E Make It Rain.
MissFortune.combo: Save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit instead of using it in your combo when you may need it to dodge the slow from Miss Fortune E Make It Rain or Miss Fortune R Bullet Time.
MissFortune.escape: Miss Fortune has no mobility spell, so look for a chance to close the gap with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit from outside the slow zone of Miss Fortune E Make It Rain. If the zone is active, move outside it first. If Miss Fortune R Bullet Time starts, move to the side of its fixed cone.
MissFortune.fight: Delay your approach while Miss Fortune E Make It Rain is active, and look for an angle to engage Miss Fortune from outside the zone. Lucian E Relentless Pursuit can close the gap, but first decide whether to save it for an escape in a dangerous moment.
MissFortune.laning: Position to the side, out of line with the minions, to avoid the bounce from Miss Fortune Q Double Up. After Miss Fortune last-hits a minion, create distance so you don’t get hit by her next basic attack. You can target a front minion with Lucian Q Piercing Light to hit Miss Fortune behind it, then retreat behind minions after trading.
MissFortune.phase: The available information isn’t enough to determine who is stronger in the mid or late game, so deal damage in short trades and back off instead of extending fights.
MissFortune.watch: Miss Fortune Q Double Up bounces off its first target, so don’t stand directly behind a minion. Don’t start a fight while slowed by Miss Fortune E Make It Rain. When Miss Fortune R Bullet Time starts, move to the side of its fixed cone instead of only backing away.

Seraphine.teamfight: Spread out to keep Seraphine R Encore from reaching the back line through your allies. Lucian should avoid engaging head-on and approach from the side or follow up to finish a target already caught by crowd control. Before closing in, apply the mark from Lucian W Ardent Blaze to gain movement speed, and save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to disengage.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets, so if you’re slowed, use Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to leave the straight line in front of Seraphine. Seraphine R Encore gains range each time it hits one of your allied champions, so don’t line up with allies during team fights.
Seraphine.build: Build magic resistance first. Seraphine P Stage Presence, Seraphine Q High Note, and Seraphine E Beat Drop all deal magic damage, so magic resistance is more effective than armor.
Seraphine.escape: Right after Seraphine E Beat Drop is used, you can go in with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit. Seraphine has no mobility spell, so it’s difficult for her to get away once you close the gap.
Seraphine.fight: The moment after Seraphine E Beat Drop is used is a chance to engage.
Seraphine.laning: Push the wave and use Lucian Q Piercing Light on a front minion to harass Seraphine behind it.

TwistedFate.phase: Early on, use Lucian’s strong short trades to gain an advantage in lane. Starting in the mid game, watch for Twisted Fate R Destiny roams and alert your allies. The available information isn’t enough to determine who is stronger in the late game, so deal damage in short trades and back off instead of extending fights.
TwistedFate.build: Consider prioritizing magic resistance against Twisted Fate’s main damage. The available information doesn’t specify a particular item to buy first.
TwistedFate.escape: Use Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to close the gap here, but think carefully before using the dash so you can escape if things get dangerous.
TwistedFate.fight: Keep your distance while he is holding a gold card, then approach right after the card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card is consumed. Deal short damage when Lucian Q Piercing Light and an empowered basic attack are ready, and use Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to manage the distance.
TwistedFate.laning: Stand behind minions to reduce poke from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards. Use Lucian Q Piercing Light on a front minion to hit Twisted Fate behind it, then retreat behind minions again after trading.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Approach from the side and finish Twisted Fate right after he uses his gold card or when he is already caught by crowd control. Before engaging, apply the mark from Lucian W Ardent Blaze to gain movement speed, and save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to disengage.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate is holding a gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, it will stun you with one basic attack, so stay out of his range.

Ezreal.build: Prioritize movement speed to help you get on Ezreal. Ezreal Q Mystic Shot deals physical damage, while Ezreal W Essence Flux and Ezreal E Arcane Shift deal magic damage, so if you need resistances, consider both armor and magic resistance.
Ezreal.escape: The moment after Ezreal uses Ezreal E Arcane Shift is your chance to go in. Close the gap with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit, but keep in mind that being hit repeatedly by Ezreal Q Mystic Shot makes Ezreal E Arcane Shift come back sooner.
Ezreal.fight: Make Ezreal use Ezreal E Arcane Shift first, then close the gap, deal burst damage, and leave before the fight drags on.
Ezreal.laning: Move among your minions to block Ezreal Q Mystic Shot, and use Lucian Q Piercing Light on a front minion to harass Ezreal behind it. Push the wave, but move back behind your minions as soon as the trade is over.
Ezreal.phase: The available information doesn’t establish a definite advantage in mid or late game. After that, create an angle to get on Ezreal and deal brief damage instead of trading long-range poke or dragging out the fight.
Ezreal.teamfight: Don’t trade poke with Ezreal from long range; approach from the side or follow up. Gain movement speed with Lucian W Ardent Blaze to finish a target already caught by crowd control, and save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit for disengaging.
Ezreal.watch: Move behind minions to block Ezreal Q Mystic Shot. If Ezreal W Essence Flux marks you, briefly move out of range because his next attack will deal extra damage. When low on health, retreat at an angle to avoid the straight path of Ezreal R Trueshot Barrage.

Jhin.build: Jhin’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Jhin E Captive Audience.
Jhin.escape: Jhin has no skill to create distance on his own, so you can close the gap with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit after dodging Jhin W Deadly Flourish and during his reload. Delay your engage if Jhin has his fourth shot ready or you need Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to disengage.
Jhin.fight: Take short trades while Jhin is reloading or has just fired one or two shots, and Lucian Q Piercing Light and Lucian P Lightslinger are ready. If you need to close the gap after dodging Jhin W Deadly Flourish, use Lucian E Relentless Pursuit, but save it when you need an escape.
Jhin.laning: Push the wave and use Lucian Q Piercing Light on a front minion to harass Jhin behind it. Jhin Q Dancing Grenade can grow stronger after killing a target, so stand a step away from low-health minions. Move back behind your minions after the trade.
Jhin.phase: In mid and late game, keep taking short trades and disengaging with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit instead of fighting for a long time. The available information doesn’t establish which side is stronger in mid and late game.
Jhin.teamfight: Let your frontline take Jhin W Deadly Flourish, the shots from Jhin R Curtain Call, and the traps first. Then approach from the side or follow up to finish a target already immobilized. Gain movement speed with Lucian W Ardent Blaze before approaching, and save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit for disengaging.
Jhin.watch: Jhin P Whisper’s fourth shot deals heavy damage, so back off while he has it ready. Immediately after being hit by Jhin’s basic attack or Jhin E Captive Audience, move out of the narrow line of Jhin W Deadly Flourish. When low on health, dodge Jhin R Curtain Call.

Kaisa.build: Build armor first to reduce the physical damage from Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain. Kai'Sa P Second Skin and Kai'Sa W Void Seeker deal magic damage, which armor won’t block, so if you don’t have enough damage to kill her in one burst, build magic resistance and health as well.
Kaisa.escape: Conversely, if Kai'Sa W Void Seeker hits you, watch for Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct to engage and fall back until the mark disappears.
Kaisa.fight: Take short trades when Lucian Q Piercing Light and the empowered basic attack from Lucian P Lightslinger are both ready. If Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct is down, close the gap with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit, deal burst damage, and leave before the fight drags on.
Kaisa.laning: Use Lucian Q Piercing Light on a front minion to harass Kai'Sa behind it, then move back behind your minions after the trade. Don’t separate from the wave when Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain is expected.
Kaisa.phase: In mid game, repeat short fights based on that advantage. In late game, avoid long fights so Kai'Sa doesn’t have time to keep dealing damage with basic attacks, and quickly finish her when she engages.
Kaisa.teamfight: Gain movement speed with Lucian W Ardent Blaze, then approach Kai'Sa from the side or follow up and attack her once she’s immobilized. If she comes in with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct, focus her with your allies when she’s immobilized, even while her shield is active, and save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit for disengaging. When using Lucian R The Culling, line up with Kai'Sa; if your angle shifts, adjust your position during the cast with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit.
Kaisa.watch: Right after being hit by Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, watch for Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct to engage because of the mark. Fall back toward your allies until the mark disappears. When Kai'Sa looks likely to use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain, stay near allied minions to spread the damage. When low on health, if stacks of Kai'Sa P Second Skin build up, move out of range and wait for them to wear off.

Kalista.build: Build armor first to deal with the physical damage from Kalista Q Pierce and Kalista E Rend. Armor cannot block Kalista W Sentinel, which deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone.
Kalista.escape: Look for an opening while Kalista R Fate's Call is down. Kalista can still hop with Kalista P Martial Poise, so check that you have an exit before closing the gap with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit.
Kalista.fight: Take short trades when Lucian Q Piercing Light and Lucian P Lightslinger are ready. Aim Lucian Q Piercing Light at the start of Kalista’s basic attack animation. If Kalista could throw her support with Kalista R Fate's Call, save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit as a way to dodge it.
Kalista.laning: Use Lucian Q Piercing Light on a front minion to harass Kalista behind it. After trading, retreat behind minions. While Kalista’s basic attack is in flight, break her vision by moving behind brush or a wall to reduce the damage you take.
Kalista.phase: The available information isn’t enough to determine which champion is stronger in the mid or late game, so keep taking short trades and backing off instead of committing to long fights.
Kalista.teamfight: Spread out in advance if Kalista looks ready to throw her support with Kalista R Fate's Call. Lucian should approach from the side or follow up to attack a target that is already immobilized. Gain movement speed from the mark of Lucian W Ardent Blaze, then save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to disengage.
Kalista.watch: When Kalista has stacked several spears with basic attacks, watch out for the damage and slow from Kalista E Rend. If your health gets low while spears are stacked, stop fighting and back away until they disappear. If Kalista’s support is nearby, Kalista can throw them with Kalista R Fate's Call, so avoid where they would land.

KogMaw.build: Build magic resistance first to deal with Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle, Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage, and Kog'Maw E Void Ooze. Armor also helps against the physical damage from his basic attacks, and reducing his attack speed is effective. Avoid relying on health alone because of Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage.
KogMaw.combo: Line up with Kog'Maw before starting Lucian R The Culling. You can keep your angle during the channel with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit.
KogMaw.escape: Kog'Maw has no mobility spell to create distance, so the window after Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage expires is a chance to close in with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit. Go in from an angle where Kog'Maw E Void Ooze won’t slow you, and save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to disengage if the approach is risky.
KogMaw.fight: After Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage expires, take a short trade when Lucian Q Piercing Light and Lucian P Lightslinger are ready.
KogMaw.laning: Early on, push the wave to disrupt Kog'Maw’s farming, and use Lucian Q Piercing Light on a front minion to harass Kog'Maw behind it.
KogMaw.teamfight: Approach from the side or follow up instead of initiating head-on, and target Kog'Maw once he is immobilized. Before closing in, apply the mark from Lucian W Ardent Blaze to gain movement speed, and save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to disengage. If you kill Kog'Maw, immediately move away from his body to avoid Kog'Maw P Icathian Surprise.
KogMaw.watch: When Kog'Maw activates Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage, its range increases and his basic attacks deal damage based on your maximum health, so keep your distance until it expires. Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle reduces armor and magic resistance, so block it from behind minions or dodge to the side. If slowed by Kog'Maw E Void Ooze, don’t force an approach. Watch out for Kog'Maw R Living Artillery, which deals more damage to low-health targets. After killing Kog'Maw, move away from his body to avoid Kog'Maw P Icathian Surprise.
KogMaw.phase: Kog'Maw gets stronger as the game goes on, so secure objectives and towers in mid game to speed up the game. Long fights in the late game favor Kog'Maw, so repeatedly go in briefly, deal damage, and back off.

Smolder.build: Build armor first to deal with the physical damage from Smolder R MMOOOMMMM!. Resistance cannot block the true damage from Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath, which also deals damage based on maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone.
Smolder.combo: Using abilities in quick succession makes you miss empowered basic attacks, so weave abilities and basic attacks while Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down.
Smolder.escape: The moment after Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is used is a chance to engage, so close the gap with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit then. Don’t use Lucian E Relentless Pursuit too early if you failed to dodge the slow from Smolder W Achooo! or Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is still available.
Smolder.fight: Right after Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is used, close the gap with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit and deal short burst damage. After dodging Smolder W Achooo!, trade when both Lucian Q Piercing Light and your empowered basic attack are ready, then back off.
Smolder.laning: Smolder is weak early and gets stronger as he stacks, so pressure him from the early to mid game and limit his chances to farm minions with Q. Use Lucian Q Piercing Light on a front minion to hit Smolder behind it, then retreat behind minions after trading.
Smolder.phase: Early game is when Lucian can make strong trades and disrupt Smolder’s farming. In the mid game, use your advantage to take objectives and turrets quickly. The same approach to fighting becomes less favorable as Smolder accumulates permanent stacks into the late game.
Smolder.teamfight: Approach from the side or follow up instead of initiating head-on, and finish Smolder once he is already caught by crowd control. Gain movement speed from the mark of Lucian W Ardent Blaze, and save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to disengage. Move away from the area hit by Smolder R MMOOOMMMM!, then attack again.
Smolder.watch: Being hit by Smolder W Achooo! slows you and makes it easier to get hit by follow-up attacks, so dodge by standing behind minions or moving to the side. When Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! lands, move out of its center and the flames beneath Smolder, then approach again after the healing ends. Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath gains true damage and an execute as he scales, so don’t let fights drag on when your health is low.

Vayne.build: Prioritize armor against the physical damage from Vayne Q Tumble and Vayne E Condemn. Vayne W Silver Bolts deals true damage that scales with max health, so avoid choices that only add a large amount of health. Also consider an item that reduces attack speed to take fewer basic attacks from Vayne.
Vayne.combo: After Vayne Q Tumble is down, use this combo to close the gap, but save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit if Vayne E Condemn could stun you against a wall from your position.
Vayne.escape: Right after Vayne Q Tumble is used, you have an opening to engage with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit. If Vayne E Condemn is down too, you have less reason to worry about being stunned against a wall, so attack briefly and back off. Do not engage if Vayne E Condemn is available and your back is to a wall.
Vayne.fight: Right after Vayne Q Tumble is used, you have a chance to close the gap with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit, but do not go in if your position with your back to a wall lets Vayne E Condemn stun you. Alternate abilities and basic attacks, then disengage when the trade is over.
Vayne.laning: Push the wave to pressure Vayne's farming and gain an early advantage. You can use Lucian Q Piercing Light on a front minion to poke Vayne behind it. After trading, fall back behind minions and avoid positions with your back to a wall.
Vayne.phase: Early, use Lucian's short, strong trades to pressure Vayne while her health and armor are low. In the mid game, convert that lead into turrets and objectives. The matchup gets worse in the late game once Vayne has attack speed and penetration items, so avoid long fights.
Vayne.teamfight: Fight in open areas and do not give Vayne E Condemn a chance to stun you against a wall in a narrow passage. Apply the mark from Lucian W Ardent Blaze to gain movement speed, then approach from the side or follow up to finish a target already caught by your team's crowd control. Save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to disengage.
Vayne.watch: Vayne E Condemn stuns if it knocks you into a wall, so do not fight with your back to one. Vayne W Silver Bolts deals max-health-based true damage when attacks stack on the same target, so if you have been hit several times, get out of range before it triggers.

Xayah.build: Xayah's main damage is physical, so prioritize armor. The information provided does not specify a particular item to buy first.
Xayah.combo: If the return path of Xayah E Bladecaller is dangerous, do not use E in your combo; save it to sidestep.
Xayah.escape: After dodging the root path of Xayah E Bladecaller, close the gap with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit.
Xayah.fight: Lucian should take short trades when Q Piercing Light and P Lightslinger are ready. Reposition and back off before Xayah can stack feathers. After Xayah R Featherstorm is down, close the gap with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit.
Xayah.laning: Cast Lucian Q Piercing Light through a minion to poke Xayah behind it. Push the wave, take a short trade, then fall back behind minions. Do not fight in the same spot for long and let Xayah stack feathers.
Xayah.phase: In the mid game, pressure Xayah while Xayah R Featherstorm is down. In the late game, keep taking short trades and backing off instead of extending fights.
Xayah.teamfight: Do not dive in too far while Xayah R Featherstorm is available; approach from the side or follow up after it is down. Apply the mark from Lucian W Ardent Blaze before closing in to gain movement speed, and save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to disengage.
Xayah.watch: Xayah E Bladecaller roots if it hits you with three or more returning feathers. If three or more feathers lie along the line between you and Xayah, use Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to sidestep. Do not dive in too far while Xayah R Featherstorm is available.

Yasuo.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and R Last Breath. Armor can’t block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.combo: If you need to dodge Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s tornado, save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to evade it instead of using it mid-combo.
Yasuo.fight: Right after Yasuo throws his tornado, he has no way to knock you up for a while, so engage during that window and retreat before the trade goes long.
Yasuo.laning: Use Lucian Q Piercing Light on a front minion to hit and harass Yasuo behind it. Manage the wave so it stays thin while pushing toward your side, reducing the minions Yasuo can use to approach with E Sweeping Blade. Retreat behind your minions after trading, and adjust your distance with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit when Yasuo engages.
Yasuo.teamfight: Lucian should avoid engaging from the front and instead approach from the side or follow up to finish targets already caught by crowd control. Apply Lucian W Ardent Blaze’s mark before closing in to gain movement speed, and save E Relentless Pursuit to disengage. If Yasuo W Wind Wall blocks the path of a key ability, change your angle or wait for the wall to disappear.
Yasuo.watch: After being hit by Yasuo Q Steel Tempest twice, watch for the next tornado’s knock-up and move sideways out of its line. Yasuo can dash in with E Sweeping Blade through minions, so save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to dodge when there are plenty of minions he can use to approach. If Yasuo uses W Wind Wall, go around it or save key abilities until it disappears.
Yasuo.escape: The moment right after Yasuo throws the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest is your chance to engage. Before Yasuo R Last Breath is available again, you can use Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to close the gap in response to crowd control, but don’t go in just because Yasuo E Sweeping Blade is down.

Zeri.build: Zeri's main damage from Zeri Q Burst Fire and Zeri W Ultrashock Laser is physical, so prioritize armor. Also account for the max-health-based damage and execute threshold from Zeri P Living Battery by considering your total health. The provided information does not specify Lucian's particular purchase items.
Zeri.combo: Save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit when you need to dodge Zeri's retaliation.
Zeri.escape: Right after you make Zeri use Zeri E Spark Surge, and after dodging Zeri W Ultrashock Laser, you can close the gap with Lucian E Relentless Pursuit. Engage in open terrain because Zeri can escape over a wall. Do not use Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to engage if you need it to dodge.
Zeri.fight: Right after Zeri E Spark Surge is used, you have a chance to close the gap. Do not let a fight drag on while Zeri R Lightning Crash is active.
Zeri.laning: Gain an advantage with Lucian's strong early trades before Zeri completes her core items. Lucian Q Piercing Light can hit Zeri behind a front minion. After trading, fall back behind minions and avoid walls where Zeri W Ultrashock Laser can spread.
Zeri.phase: Once Zeri completes her core items, her mobility makes her difficult to pick off, so take short fights repeatedly from the mid game onward. The provided information is not enough to determine who has the advantage in the late game.
Zeri.teamfight: Approach from the side or follow up to finish Zeri after she is immobilized rather than engaging head-on. Apply the mark from Lucian W Ardent Blaze first to gain movement speed, and save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to disengage. If Zeri R Lightning Crash is active, do not chase recklessly; look for a moment when she is immobilized.
Zeri.watch: Zeri W Ultrashock Laser spreads widely when it hits terrain, so do not stand with your back to a wall or face her head-on in a narrow passage. Zeri E Spark Surge travels farther when crossing a wall, so do not corner her against one. After Zeri R Lightning Crash is activated, her movement speed increases, so do not chase her on foot.

Ziggs.build: The information provided is not enough to determine your first purchase. If you build resistance against Ziggs's magic damage, choose magic resistance, and also consider movement speed to leave the warned landing areas of Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb and Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb.
Ziggs.escape: If you engage right after Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down, Ziggs cannot escape with that mobility ability. If Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield blocks your approach, do not use Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to enter it; go around or wait for the mines to disappear.
Ziggs.fight: Right after Ziggs W Satchel Charge is used for poke or wave clear, you have a chance to close the gap.
Ziggs.laning: You can use Lucian Q Piercing Light on a front minion to poke Ziggs behind it. If Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down, look for a chance to re-engage from a direction not blocked by Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield.
Ziggs.phase: Early, gain a lane advantage with Lucian's strong, short trades. The provided information is not enough to determine who has the advantage in the mid or late game. As fights drag on, it becomes harder to make use of Lucian's strength in burst damage, so look for short trades and back off.
Ziggs.teamfight: Approach from the side or follow up to finish Ziggs after he is caught by crowd control rather than engaging head-on. Before closing in, apply the mark from Lucian W Ardent Blaze to gain movement speed, and save Lucian E Relentless Pursuit to disengage. If Ziggs W Satchel Charge is available, check his escape route over walls too, and stay away from the center of the warning area for Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb.
Ziggs.watch: Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield slows you and makes it easier to hit you with follow-up abilities, so avoid the area or wait for it to disappear. When the warning area for Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb appears, move away from the center of the explosion even if you cannot fully escape the area. If Ziggs W Satchel Charge is available, check your approach path because it can knock you away or let Ziggs escape over a wall.
